name: EURING Code 2000
description: EURING code version from 2000 - complex fixed-length format with alphanumeric codes

field_definitions.name: biometrics
field_definitions.description: Reserved columns: wing length, primary length, weight, tarsus, fat, skull ossification, moult, tail length, tail difference, bill length, bill depth, head and bill, toe, claws, etc.
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Unstructured reserved block historically holding biometric measurements (wing length, primary length, weight, tarsus, fat score, skull ossification, moult, tail length, tail difference, bill length, bill depth, head and bill, toe, claws); not split into individual EURING2020 biometric fields, so it has no single corresponding 2020 field.

field_definitions.name: elapsed time
field_definitions.description: calculated as the elapsed time between the current record and the first record (= ringing data). The elapsed time is given in days (00000-99999)
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Elapsed time in days between this record and the first (ringing) record.

field_definitions.name: direction
field_definitions.description: Calculated by computer as the direction between the current record and the first record (= ringing data). the direction is given in degrees (000-359)
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Direction in degrees from the first (ringing) record to this record.

field_definitions.name: distance
field_definitions.description: Calculated by computer as the distance between the current record and the first record (= ringing data). The distance is given in kilometres (00000-99999)
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Distance in kilometres between this record and the first (ringing) record.

field_definitions.name: EURING code identifier
field_definitions.description: Identifies which version of coding (1966, 1979 or 2000) is used
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Identifies which EURING code version was used to encode this record.

field_definitions.name: circumstances presumed
field_definitions.description: Can be used in combination with the entries in the filed "circumstances" to modify the circumstances
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Whether the recorded circumstances are certain or presumed.

field_definitions.name: circumstances
field_definitions.description: Circostanze dell'evento di cattura
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Circumstances under which the bird was encountered.

field_definitions.name: condition

field_definitions.name: geographical coordinates
field_definitions.description:
Latitude: North and South coordinates are given in quadrant, degrees, minutes, seconds
Longitude: East and West coordinates are given in quadrant, degrees, minutes, seconds
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Encoded latitude/longitude of the event location (degrees/minutes/seconds format).

field_definitions.name: place code
field_definitions.description:
The purpose of the Place Code is solely to identify particular geographical areas in terms of current administrative regions.
FIRST PAIR of characters identifying the country
SECOND PAIR of characters identifying the sub-division of the country
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: EURING place code identifying the geographical area of the event.

field_definitions.name: time
field_definitions.description: The actual time of the day in hours and minutes, according to a 24 hour clock in local time
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Time of day of the event, 24-hour local time.

field_definitions.name: accuracy of date
field_definitions.description: Date accurato to within...
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Accuracy of the recorded date.

field_definitions.name: date
field_definitions.description: The date in days, months and years to be coded
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Date of the ringing/encounter event.

field_definitions.name: accuracy of pullus age
field_definitions.description:
- bird is not a pullus
0 accurate to the day
n accurate to within n days either side of day coded
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Accuracy of the recorded pullus age, in days either side.

field_definitions.name: pullus age
field_definitions.description:
-- bird is not a pullus
99 pullus age not recorded
00 pullus age 0 days
nn pullus age n days
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Age in days of a pullus (nestling).

field_definitions.name: broodsize
field_definitions.description:
-- bird is not a nestling
00 unknown, not coded
nn n chicks in the nest
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Number of nestlings in the brood, for nestling records only.

field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Status of the full-grown bird (e.g. free-flying, in captivity).

field_definitions.name: identification number
field_definitions.description: Ring number, consisting of up to ten figures and/or letters, to be coded directly into the ten columns
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: The ring number identifying this individual bird, up to ten alphanumeric characters.

field_definitions.name: primary identification methos
field_definitions.description: This field is to denote the primary method used to identify a bird
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Primary method used to identify the bird (e.g. metal ring, colour ring, other mark).

field_definitions.name: ringing scheme
field_definitions.description: Ringing schemes are here defined as centres issuing rings
field_definitions.semantic_meaning: Code identifying the ringing scheme (issuing centre) responsible for the ring.

validation_rules.error_message: Scheme code must be 4 uppercase alphanumeric characters
Ring prefix must be 3 uppercase alphanumeric characters
Ring number must be exactly 7 digits
Ring suffix must be 2 uppercase letters
First date must be exactly 5 digits
Current date must be exactly 5 digits
Age code must be a single digit
Latitude value must be exactly 6 digits
Longitude value must be exactly 6 digits
Final code must be exactly 5 digits
